prompt:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

Strict side view for a 2D side-scrolling game, the camera is level with the ground (not from above). Characters face RIGHT.
Tiles and background layers marked "connect seamlessly" must match exactly at the LEFT and RIGHT edges so they can repeat.
Mid layers: draw only the lower part, leave the upper part empty flat #FF00FF magenta.

Use case: illustration-story. Original Windup Town game art. References: primary original style anchor; character reference for drawing technique ONLY, never copy its character or text; stage and watercolor technique references; existing road background for format. Match thick plum outlines, watercolor texture. New chapter palette: dusty pink, pastel cream, muted gold.

A wide sprite sheet with EXACTLY THREE separated objects in ONE horizontal row, equal cell widths, 100px gutters on pure #FF00FF. Reading left to right: shaking brown parcel; overwound wooden music box; same music box calm. Each silhouette at least 350px high; full figures, no labels. Music boxes must be identical aged reddish-brown wood designs, same size, brass trim and same tiny porcelain pink ballerina. Keep motion marks close so each cell is one cluster. No floor or cast shadow.

a small brown paper parcel tied with string, shaking with motion lines, a postage stamp shape with no text

an old small wooden music box with the lid rattling open, a tiny ballerina figure spinning madly, the key on its side wound tight and glowing, screeching sound lines

the same old wooden music box open and calm, the tiny ballerina turning gently, soft music notes floating

EDIT LAST IMAGE only cleanup for chroma-key extraction. Preserve all 3 designs, sizes, layout and pose. Remove ALL translucent motion ghosts, transparent smears, glow halos and pink/magenta blended strokes outside objects. Replace them with a few SOLID OPAQUE cream/gold curved motion lines with dark-plum outlines. Fill ALL holes of the two gold wind-up keys with pure #FF00FF magenta matching background, not pale pink. Also every hole between ballerina limbs and box must be exact magenta when not over wood. Do NOT change actual pink tutu or wood pigment. Keep crisp clean outlines, pure solid #FF00FF surrounding all silhouettes. No ground shadows.
reason: Remove chroma spill from translucent ghosts and fill winding-key holes with keyable magenta.
